tests.name: Load_WithMalformedJson_ReportsConfigurationPath
tests.description: Malformed JSON fails with sanitized, actionable configuration context.
tests.arrange: A configuration file containing malformed JSON.
tests.assert: A configuration error reports the file path and malformed-json category.

tests.name: Load_WithUnreadableFile_ReportsSanitizedReadError
tests.description: Configuration read failures are distinct from missing-file defaults.
tests.arrange: An existing configuration path whose read operation raises OSError.
tests.assert: A sanitized configuration error reports the path and unreadable-file category.

tests.name: Load_WithWrongTypedKnownContainer_RejectsContainer
tests.description: Known defaults and skills containers must be JSON objects.
tests.arrange: Configurations with a non-object root, defaults, skills, skill name, or skill profile.
tests.assert: Each load fails with an error identifying the affected container.

tests.name: Load_WithInvalidKnownProfileValue_RejectsBeforeRun
tests.description: Explicit null, empty, wrong-typed, and unsupported known values are invalid.
tests.arrange: Default, legacy, and skill fields containing invalid model or permission_mode values.
tests.act: Construct DevinHarness from the configuration and attempt invocation.
tests.assert: Validation identifies the scope and field, and the subprocess runner is never called.

tests.name: Resolve_WithUnknownKeys_IgnoresThemAndPreservesKnownFields
tests.description: Unknown top-level and profile keys remain forward compatible.
tests.arrange: Structured defaults and a skill override containing unknown keys.
tests.act: Resolve the skill and run the harness.
tests.assert: Known fields resolve normally and unknown values never appear in the command.

tests.name: Run_WithInvocationSkill_UsesFreshEffectiveProfileCommand
tests.description: Each invocation uses canonical skill context and a fresh effective profile.
tests.arrange: Defaults plus two partial skill overrides and invocation contexts for each skill.
tests.act: Run the shared harness for both skills.
tests.assert: Each list-valued command has separate expected model and permission arguments without cross-invocation mutation.

tests.name: Run_WithRestrictedProfileFailure_DoesNotEscalateOrRetry
tests.description: Failure under auto remains under auto without broader permission retry.
tests.arrange: An auto profile and a runner returning a denied-write/nonzero result.
tests.assert: The runner is called once with auto and the original failure is returned.

tests.name: Run_WithResolvedProfile_LogsSafeSelection
tests.description: Activity telemetry records only canonical skill, model, and permission mode for profile selection.
tests.arrange: An activity log context, configured skill profile, and a prompt containing sensitive marker text.
tests.assert: The activity log records the selected profile and excludes the prompt and raw configuration.

tests.name: RepositoryConfig_ForStoryAnalysisWriters_UsesExplicitAcceptEdits
tests.description: The colocated example config opts artifact-producing Story Analysis skills into workspace edits.
tests.act: Load and resolve representative Story Analysis writer and read-only skills.
tests.assert: Writers explicitly resolve to accept-edits while the global default remains auto.
